page.overview:
Who is Curse Jutsu Master?

The Curse Jutsu Master is a mysterious ninja that Naruto Uzumaki meets in the story mode of Naruto Shippūden: Ultimate Ninja Storm 2. Kakashi Hatake refers to him as one of unique individuals that can instil their chakra into dolls.

He first meets Naruto and Sakura Haruno when they defeated a curse doll that took the appearance of Naruto. Later, he assigns Naruto to defeat and collect the thirty-seven curse dolls scattered throughout the map. After Naruto has defeated and claimed the dolls, the Curse Jutsu Master reveals that he was the one that scattered the dolls and he intends to create the "ultimate ninja" to destroy all the ninja villages and countries.

He flees the village while Naruto fights off six of his dolls. Tsunade sends a search party for his location and later discover that he fled to Orochimaru's abandoned hideout near Kusagakure. Naruto fights through the dolls guarding the hideout and finds the Curse Jutsu Master defeated by his ultimate ninja creation that has taken the form of Naruto in Sage Mode. After Naruto destroys the last doll, the Curse Jutsu Master was taken in custody by Konohagakure.
